about:
Results driven business leader with demonstrated success in leading organization through transition; growth, restructuring and disposition. Background in Operations & Project Management. Energized by challenging situations that cross functions and require engaging a diverse group to meet a mutual goal. Strong reputation for being the go-to resource with flawless execution. Senior CXO level business partner with well-developed team building and management skills that complement a strong entrepreneurial drive and sense of ownership. 

 International Business Endeavors – Leveraged an excellent foundation of operational knowledge for global markets to help build success in Turnaround of the International Business Operations. Driving Positivity and implementing Growth Based Operating Model. Markets developed include Philippines, Malaysia, Singapore, India as well as Canada, Australia. Current revenues in these geographies exceed US $ 100 million.

Major Focus Areas of Expertise Include:
• Transformational Change: History of leading organization and departments through major changes by developing and executing strategic road maps encompassing organizational, people, process, and technology improvements.
• Operational Excellence: Experience driving enterprise continuous improvement initiatives, projects and portfolios. Spearhead driving continuous improvement culture and leading successful improvements.
• Strategy and Execution: Ability to quickly assess current state against industry benchmarks, best practices, customer feedback and leading technology advances to determine and clearly communicate a vision and strategic roadmap. Proven track record of converting that plan into actionable milestones and driving timely and quality execution.

Collabera is ranked amongst the top 10 Information Technology (IT) staffing firms in the U.S., with more than $750 million in sales revenue and a global presence that represents approximately 16,000+ professionals across North America (U.S., Canada), Asia Pacific (India, Philippines, Singapore, Malaysia), and Europe (Ireland, Netherlands, Poland, United Kingdom). We support our clients with a strong recruitment model and a sincere commitment to their success, which is why more than 75% of our clients rank us amongst their top three staffing suppliers.

 Collabera has over 50 offices across the globe with a presence in ten countries and provides staff augmentation, managed services and direct placement services to global 2000 corporations.
